publication: Anand Pillay, Lecture notes on strongly minimal sets (and fields) with a generic automorphism, author-hosted 52-page PDF. Date not established from the inspected pages.

reviews.checked_passages: Planning selection: printed pp.2–10, especially the definition of strongly minimal theories accompanying Fact3.1 on p.5.
reviews.consumers: [Strong minimality and algebraic closure](entries/strongly-minimal-sets/entry.html): the finite/cofinite definition only.
reviews.outcome: Only the finite/cofinite definition is selected as supporting context. Generic automorphisms, DMP, ranks and field-theoretic applications are not adopted; their compressed proofs and exercises are not certified here. The elementary uniform-bound and exchange arguments require their own exposition.
